title: FAQ: Silver Account
summary: This FAQ for the Rho-Bank “Silver Account” covers Silver APY tiers (2.5% lower tier, 4.0% higher tier), the $1,000 minimum balance requirement and $5.00 monthly maintenance fee if not met, and an excess withdrawal fee of $2.00 per additional withdrawal beyond the monthly limit. It also explains a 0.025% relationship APY bonus for eligible multi-product customers and ATM fee rebates up to 15 per month.
faqs: What APY does the Silver Account pay, and how does it vary by balance tier?
What is the minimum balance for the Silver Account, and what is the $5.00 fee if I miss it?
Is there an excess withdrawal fee if I withdraw more than the monthly limit?
How does the relationship APY bonus work for customers with multiple Rho-Bank products?
Do you rebate ATM fees, and what is the monthly rebate limit?
